story_overview: MSVBench story 41 (American Novels). Ennis Del Mar wakes up on a windy morning in an old trailer. As time passes, Ennis and Jack’s relationship becomes increasingly complicated. Ennis’s truck gradually disappears into the distance, carrying his memories of Jack as he moves forward.

video_prompts: Early morning, inside an old trailer, wind howling, dim lighting, the trailer is cluttered, a shirt hanging on a nail trembles slightly, wind seeps through the gaps in the doors and windows, the bed is messy, a half-empty glass of water is on the table, old photos hang on the wall. Ennis lies on the bed, eyes half-open, looking exhausted, hair disheveled, the blanket partially covering him, a shirt hanging on a nail trembles slightly. Ennis Del Mar wakes up on a windy morning in an old trailer. Medium shot, eye level shot.

Early morning, inside an old trailer, wind howling, dim lighting, the trailer is cluttered, the bed is messy, a half-empty glass of water is on the table, old photos hang on the wall, a pair of worn-out leather boots are in the corner. Ennis sits on the edge of the bed, putting on his jeans, looking determined, his shoulders slightly hunched, his chest slightly concave, muscular, the worn-out leather boots placed by his feet. Ennis gets up, puts on his jeans and worn-out leather boots, ready to start a new day. Medium close up, eye level shot.

Early morning, inside an old trailer, wind howling, dim lighting, the trailer is cluttered, a small kitchen area with a stove and coffee pot, a half-empty glass of water is on the table, old photos hang on the wall. Ennis stands by the stove, holding a coffee pot, lost in thought, his gaze fixed ahead as if reminiscing, steam rising from the coffee pot. Ennis brews leftover coffee and recalls dreaming about Jack Twist the night before. Medium shot, side shot.

Early morning, inside an old trailer, wind howling, dim lighting, the trailer is cluttered, old photos hang on the wall, including one from their youth showing Ennis and Jack together on Brokeback Mountain. Close-up of the old photo on the wall, showing Ennis and Jack standing side by side with Brokeback Mountain in the background, both looking young and happy. Jack was his friend from their youth when they herded sheep together on Brokeback Mountain, and also the one he deeply loved. Close up, close up shot.

Early morning, inside an old trailer, wind howling, dim lighting, the trailer is cluttered, old photos hang on the wall, Ennis stands before the photo, a half-empty glass of water is on the table. Ennis stands before the wall, gazing at the old photo, his expression affectionate and sorrowful, his right hand gently touching Jack in the photo. Though they hadn’t seen each other for years, Ennis still couldn’t forget Jack. Medium close up, eye level shot.

Daytime, Brokeback Mountain pasture, blue sky with white clouds, a flock of sheep in the distance, wildflowers blooming on the grassland, a gentle breeze blowing, serene and beautiful. Panoramic view of the vast pasture, dotted with sheep, the grassland undulating in the wind, the scene peaceful and expansive. Ennis and Jack both came from impoverished farm families. They met on Brokeback Mountain in their youth and spent an unforgettable summer together. Wide shot, bird's eye view shot.

Daytime, Brokeback Mountain pasture, blue sky with white clouds, a flock of sheep in the distance, wildflowers blooming on the grassland, Ennis and Jack sit side by side under a large tree. Ennis and Jack sit side by side under a large tree, Ennis looking reserved, Jack looking outgoing, their hands lightly clasped together, the background showing undulating grassland and sheep. They fell in love, but such feelings were unacceptable in society at the time. Medium shot, eye level shot.

Daytime, Brokeback Mountain pasture, blue sky with white clouds, a flock of sheep in the distance, wildflowers blooming on the grassland, Ennis and Jack stand at the edge of the pasture, preparing to part. Ennis and Jack stand at the edge of the pasture, Ennis looking somber, Jack looking reluctant, their backs turned toward each other, ready to walk in different directions. When summer ended, they were forced to part and started new lives separately. Medium long shot, side shot.

Evening, outside an old trailer, surrounded by a desolate farm, the sun setting, soft lighting, an old truck parked beside the trailer, Jack stands by the truck. Jack stands by the truck, looking expectant, his hand resting on the truck door, the glow of the sunset illuminating him, the background showing the old trailer and the desolate farm. Years later, Jack suddenly reappears in Ennis’s life. Medium shot, eye level shot.

Evening, inside an old trailer, dim lighting, the trailer is cluttered, Ennis and Jack stand face to face, the atmosphere tense and emotional. Ennis and Jack stand face to face, Ennis looking conflicted, Jack looking affectionate, their hands almost touching but restraining themselves. When they reunite, their old feelings reignite, but the constraints of reality prevent them from being together. Medium close up, eye level shot.

Evening, inside an old trailer, dim lighting, the trailer is cluttered, Ennis and Jack sit at the table, a half-empty glass of water and a farm plan on the table. Ennis and Jack sit at the table, Jack pointing at the farm plan, looking animated, Ennis looking hesitant, his hands clenched together. Jack proposes a plan to start a farm together, but Ennis declines due to family responsibilities. Medium shot, side shot.

Daytime, desolate farm, a few dilapidated farmhouses in the distance, Ennis stands alone in the center of the farm, lost in thought. Ennis stands alone in the center of the farm, surrounded by barren land and dilapidated farmhouses, lost in thought, his hands in his pockets, the background showing a vast sky. As time passes, Ennis and Jack’s relationship becomes increasingly complicated. Full shot, high-angle shot.

Evening, outside an old trailer, surrounded by a desolate farm, the sun setting, soft lighting, Ennis and Jack stand by the trailer, preparing to part. Ennis and Jack stand by the trailer, Ennis looking pained, Jack looking reluctant, they embrace tightly before Jack turns and walks toward the truck. They meet occasionally, but each parting brings them more pain. Medium long shot, side shot.

Daytime, inside an old trailer, dim lighting, the trailer is cluttered, Ennis sits on the bed, holding a telegram, looking devastated. Ennis sits on the bed, clutching the telegram, looking utterly heartbroken, tears streaming down his face, the telegram bearing the news of Jack’s death. Eventually, Jack dies in an accident, and Ennis is plunged into deep grief. Close up, close up shot.

Daytime, inside Jack’s parents’ farmhouse, simple and tidy, Jack’s photos hang on the wall, Ennis stands before an old chest, holding a shirt. Ennis stands before the old chest, holding a shirt, looking shocked and affectionate, the shirt worn but well-preserved, Jack’s photos in the background. Ennis visits Jack’s parents and discovers a shirt they once wore together, which Jack had treasured. Medium close up, eye level shot.

Daytime, inside an old trailer, dim lighting, the trailer is cluttered, Ennis stands before the wall, hanging the shirt on a nail. Ennis stands before the wall, carefully hanging the shirt on a nail, looking affectionate and solemn, the shirt swaying slightly, the background showing the cluttered interior of the trailer. This shirt becomes Ennis’s final memento of Jack. Medium shot, eye level shot.

Early morning, inside an old trailer, wind howling, dim lighting, the trailer is cluttered, the shirt and old photos hang on the wall, Ennis sits on the bed, gazing at the shirt. Ennis sits on the bed, gazing at the shirt on the wall, looking affectionate and sorrowful, the shirt trembling slightly as wind seeps through the gaps. He hangs the shirt on the trailer wall, looking at it every day, reminiscing about their past happy times. Medium close up, eye level shot.

Early morning, outside an old trailer, surrounded by a desolate farm, wind howling, Ennis stands by the trailer, preparing to pack his belongings. Ennis stands by the trailer, looking resolute yet helpless, loading his belongings onto the truck, the background showing the desolate farm and howling wind. Ennis knows he must move today because the farm has been sold. Full shot, low-angle shot.

Daytime, Brokeback Mountain pasture, blue sky with white clouds, a flock of sheep in the distance, wildflowers blooming on the grassland, Ennis and Jack sit side by side under a large tree, looking young and happy. Ennis and Jack sit side by side under a large tree, Ennis looking reserved yet happy, Jack looking outgoing, their hands lightly clasped together, the background showing undulating grassland and sheep. Ennis recalls the happy times he and Jack shared on Brokeback Mountain. Medium shot, eye level shot.

Early morning, inside an old trailer, wind howling, dim lighting, the trailer is cluttered, the shirt and old photos hang on the wall, Ennis stands before the wall, gazing at the shirt. Close-up of Ennis’s face, gazing at the shirt on the wall, looking affectionate and nostalgic, as if silently conversing with Jack. Ennis gazes affectionately at the shirt on the wall, as if Jack were still by his side. Close up, close up shot.

Early morning, outside an old trailer, surrounded by a desolate farm, wind howling, Ennis sits in the truck’s driver seat, ready to depart. Ennis sits in the truck’s driver seat, looking resolute yet sorrowful, gripping the steering wheel, gazing into the distance through the windshield, the background showing the desolate farm and howling wind. Carrying his memories of Jack, Ennis embarks on a new journey. Medium shot, eye level shot.

Early morning, desolate farm, wind howling, Ennis’s truck gradually drives into the distance, leaving a trail of dust. Panoramic view of the vast farm, Ennis’s truck gradually vanishing into the horizon, leaving a trail of dust, the background showing a vast sky and barren land. Ennis’s truck gradually disappears into the distance, carrying his memories of Jack as he moves forward. Wide shot, bird's eye view shot.
